name: simplify
description: Reduce the reasoning required to understand and safely change code.

interface.shortDescription: Make code easier to understand and safely change.
interface.longDescription: Make behavior easier to trace and changes easier to locate through clear ownership and direct data flow. Preserve useful boundaries and refactor only when there is a concrete benefit.
defaultPrompt: Simplify this code so it is easier to understand and safely change.
Review this code for worthwhile simplifications.
Refactor this code to clarify ownership without changing behavior.
